name: mnemonic_reverberant_self
label: Reverberant Self Echo
godotFeature: AnimationPlayer (record/playback), PhysicsServer3D (ghostly interaction), ShaderMaterial (visual effect), Callable (action triggers)
poeticVision: The desperate act of reaching back into your own immediate past, not to change it, but to pull a ghost of yourself forward. A shimmering, fleeting 'you' that remembers a few precious seconds of your last efforts, and offers them to your present peril. It's a bitter echo of self-reliance, a physical manifestation of what you *were* that might just save what you *are*, for a price.
usage: Attach this script to your player character or a game manager node. In the editor, assign a 'ReverbSelf.tscn' PackedScene to the 'Reverb Self Scene' export variable. This 'ReverbSelf.tscn' should be a CharacterBody3D with a MeshInstance3D child and the 'ReverbSelf.gd' script attached to its root. Call 'start_recording()' to begin capturing player movement (e.g., on a button press). Call 'activate_reverb_self()' to spawn a ghost that replays the recorded sequence (e.g., on another button press). Connect the 'ephemeral_memory_drained' and 'identity_blurred' signals to your game's resource management system to apply the associated costs and debuffs.

parameters.name: reverb_self_scene
parameters.description: The PackedScene for the Reverb Self ghost entity. This scene must contain a CharacterBody3D with the 'ReverbSelf.gd' script attached and a MeshInstance3D child.

parameters.name: record_duration
parameters.description: The duration in seconds for which player actions are recorded. This also dictates the lifespan of the spawned Reverb Self.

parameters.name: memory_cost_per_use
parameters.description: The amount of 'Ephemeral Memory' resource drained when activating a Reverb Self.

parameters.name: blur_duration
parameters.description: The duration of the temporary visual identity blur/stat debuff applied to the player.

parameters.name: blur_strength
parameters.description: The intensity of the temporary visual identity blur/stat debuff applied to the player.

dependencies: res://scenes/reverb_self.tscn (A PackedScene that serves as the template for the Reverb Self ghost. Its root node should be a CharacterBody3D with 'ReverbSelf.gd' attached, and it should have a MeshInstance3D child for visual representation.)

res://scripts/ReverbSelf.gd (A GDScript file attached to the root of 'reverb_self.tscn'. This script is responsible for playing back the recorded movement sequence and handling ghost-specific physics interactions. It expects a 'play_recorded_sequence(sequence: Array[Dictionary], lifespan_duration: float)' method.)
res://shaders/reverb_self_shader.gdshader (An optional ShaderMaterial used by the MeshInstance3D within 'reverb_self.tscn' to give the ghost a distinct, ethereal, and flickering visual effect.)
verdict: A desperate echo of self, weaponized against oblivion, this mechanic brilliantly fuses survival with the poignant cost of a fading identity.
impact: This mechanic will profoundly deepen the player's connection to Lyra's struggle, transforming tactical choices into poignant acts of self-sacrifice. Every use of the 'Reverberant Self Echo' will be a desperate gamble, a physical manifestation of Lyra's fading identity used as a shield against the Silence, forcing players to confront the very essence of what they are fighting to preserve. It adds a unique layer of strategic depth, allowing for creative solutions to immediate dangers while constantly reinforcing the core theme of self-loss and the urgency of the narrative.
